sloka: बाष्प संरुद्ध कण्ठः तु वाली स आर्त रवः शनैः ।उवाच रामम् संप्रेक्ष्य पंकलग्न इव द्विपः ॥४-१८-४९॥
transliteration: bāṣpa saṁruddha kaṇṭhaḥ tu vālī sa ārta ravaḥ śanaiḥ ।uvāca rāmam saṁprekṣya paṁkalagna iva dvipaḥ ॥4-18-49॥

translations.english: 'You are a wise man given to truth and righteousness.You remain devoted to people's wellbeing. As you know for certain about cause and effect your intellect is sound and words pleasant.
